lead.en: Monitor a host-controlled training job and inspect train and validation loss.
lead.zh: 查看宿主控制的训练任务，检查训练和验证损失。

rule.en: Status, metrics, events, errors and endpoint come from the host; the component does not train or deploy. Actions are opt-in and must be resolved by request ID. Cancel requires two presses within three seconds.
rule.zh: 状态、指标、事件、错误和端点均由宿主提供；组件不执行训练或部署。操作需显式启用并按请求 ID 返回结果。取消需在三秒内确认两次。

api.en: Provide a TrainingRunSnapshot, enable actions with with_actions, subscribe to TrainingRunRequest and call resolve. Supply a fixed positive loss ceiling when needed; the default is 2. Chart focus accepts arrows, Shift+arrows, Home, End and Escape.
api.zh: 传入 TrainingRunSnapshot，通过 with_actions 启用操作，订阅 TrainingRunRequest 并调用 resolve。可设置固定的正数损失上限，默认为 2。聚焦图表后可用方向键、Shift+方向键、Home、End 和 Escape 查看样本。

motion.en: The demo is simulated and pauses its updates when hidden. Curves currently update directly without smoothing; pointer scrubbing, result-card transitions and real screen-reader, responsive, desktop and Web acceptance remain pending.
motion.zh: 演示数据为模拟，隐藏时暂停更新。曲线目前直接更新，平滑动效、指针拖动检查、结果卡片过渡以及读屏、响应式、桌面和 Web 验收仍待完成。
